# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.
#
# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,
#             map-studio, gallery-studio, detail, components
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#
# Requested for b508: three fixes on top of b507's two changes.
#
#   tabs@timeline — the drawn glyph set, this time with the bottom eighth of the shot coming
#   back near native resolution. A 520px-tall thumbnail draws a 25pt icon in fifteen pixels,
#   which cannot tell an outline from a filled shape.
#
#   timeline:gallery — the wall of photographs. Two things changed: it now actually opens at
#   the foot on the newest month (b507 landed at the top, because the one landing attempt fired
#   before the query had delivered anything and then blocked its own retry), and the tile
#   placeholder is the sunken surface rather than near-black, so an unloaded page reads as
#   waiting rather than as holes.
#
# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph

screens=tabs@timeline,timeline:gallery
appearance=both
